# Getting help

- **Docs:** [blitzjb.github.io/claude-code-driver](https://blitzjb.github.io/claude-code-driver/): guide, architecture, API reference.
- **Questions and ideas:** [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/BlitzJB/claude-code-driver/discussions).
- **Bugs:** [open an issue](https://github.com/BlitzJB/claude-code-driver/issues/new/choose) with a minimal reproduction.
- **Security:** [report privately](https://github.com/BlitzJB/claude-code-driver/security/advisories/new).

Most surprises come from Claude Code itself changing; this library supports exactly one pinned Claude Code version
(see [Known limitations](../docs/KNOWN-LIMITATIONS.md)).
